createWindow.behavior: mints a fresh Core Document and hands it to the new Window as its strongly owned document

document.behavior: the window's live Document; repeated reads hand back one and the same JS object

destroy.behavior: eagerly destroys the document; idempotent; after the call every Core-touching operation on any handle fails per T21, while document() keeps handing back the same (now-destroyed) handle

documentContext.rule: extensions delegate every tree operation to Core; no second DOM state; no fabricated NodeId
